# @alexify/protoarray

> Zero-dependency, schema-based serialization for Node.js and browsers. Objects travel as
> positional arrays (`{ name: 'Alex', age: 27 }` becomes `['Alex', 27]`), and a schema shared by
> the client and the server maps every position back to its key. A lightweight alternative to
> Protocol Buffers, maintained by Alexis Technologies.

Key facts:
- Status: work in progress. The schema format and the API are being designed; `encode` and
  `decode` are exported as placeholders that throw
- Package (npm): `@alexify/protoarray`, installed with `npm install @alexify/protoarray`
- Node.js >= 18 and browsers; CommonJS with ESM named-import interop; hand-written `index.d.ts`
- Zero runtime dependencies, no code generation, no build step
- The payload is plain JSON: smaller than keyed objects because keys are not repeated
- Exports: `encode(schema, value)`, `decode(schema, array)`
